description: Welcome to The Hangout, where 59 ends and the fun begins. We are the ultimate beachfront destination for family-friendly fun, live entertainment, and unforgettable beachside dining. Whether you're here for the food, the music, or the memories, The Hangout is where everyone feels at home — from kids to grandparents, locals to visitors, and even your four-legged friends. We're proudly pet-friendly and designed for guests of all ages to relax, laugh, and play by the beach. There's never a dull moment at The Hangout. Guests can enjoy free live music, foam parties every hour, and a party crew that keeps the energy high throughout the day. Families love the direct beach access that allows kids to play in the sand while parents unwind with a cold drink and an ocean view. Our space is ideal for large groups, sports teams, and family gatherings, offering ample seating and convenient parking for team buses. Whether you're celebrating, traveling, or simply looking for a great meal with a view, The Hangout delivers fun, flavor, and coastal charm in every visit. The Hangout serves up more than food—it delivers memories. The flavors of the Gulf Coast inspire our menu, featuring something for everyone. Guests can dig into our famous seafood boils packed with Gulf shrimp, snow crab legs, mussels, sausage, corn, and potatoes, or enjoy signature favorites like the Lifeguard Burger, a juicy, classic topped with crispy bacon and melted cheese. Our crispy calamari, golden and lightly fried, is a guest favorite starter, and every plate is made fresh with a focus on local ingredients and Southern hospitality. From beachside seafood to classic comfort dishes and handcrafted cocktails, every bite celebrates the laid-back spirit of Gulf Shores. With its prime location on the beach, open-air dining spaces, and relaxed coastal atmosphere, The Hangout is the perfect spot for large parties, private events, and team celebrations. Whether you're dancing, singing along to live music, or enjoying a family meal by the water, every visit feels like a vacation. The Hangout Gulf Shores is where food, family, and fun come together. Join us and experience why The Hangout is more than just a restaurant—it's a Gulf Shores tradition.
